Ah, me! what would be the feelings of that noble ancestor if he could see his descendant a hunted outlaw, persecuted by the sons of those very men who once courted and caressed him, and supporting a precarious existence by the ignoble spoils of barn-yards and hen-roosts!" The hawk paused, overcome by these recollections of past glory, and the good bear said kindly,-- "Dear! dear! very sad, I'm sure. And how did this melancholy change come about, pray?" "Fashion, my dear sir!" replied the hawk, "ignoble fashion! The race of men degenerated, and occupied themselves with less lofty sports than hawking. My family, left to themselves, knew not what to do. They had been trained to pursue, to overtake, to slay, through long generations; they were unfitted for anything else. Return compact JSON without indentation. Do not repeat entities or relations. Do not create generic category nodes such as hotel or person merely to express an entity type. A relation must connect two independently identified entities and its evidence must support that specific pair.
